Though to answer your question, i don't think you have to have a fight with your best friend for him to be truly your friend. It might just be that you guys are pretty much alike and there can be no conflict between you guys because you both think on the same wavelength. As long as you can personally feel that your friend cares about you, then there is nothing to worry about.

After he said that i agreed with him and we just put the fight behind us. To this day i really appreciate what he did. It's a matter of servers. If you get DDOS'd, have massive influxes of people, either you need more servers or fix the traffic issues (you may have noticed that cloudflare thing recently here).

Fun fact: This is why many multiplayer games have online issues at launch, it's not worth it to get enough servers for the huge spike of players at launch since the concurrent players will drop to much lower and consistent amounts later on.
